Pon la avena y la leche en un bol hondo: Put the oats and the milk in a deep microwave-safe bowl. The bowl should be half empty: the oats climb as they boil and go over the edge easily.
Saca el bol con cuidado (quema) y remuev: Take the bowl out carefully (it is hot) and stir. It should have thickened into porridge; if it is still runny, heat it in 30-second bursts.

Si la pechuga es gruesa, ábrela por la m: If the breast is thick, open it out through the middle like a book so it ends up a finger thick.
Sálala por las dos caras justo antes de: Salt it on both faces just before cooking it.
Sirve con la lechuga y el tomate lavados: Serve it with the lettuce and the tomato washed and cut up.
Remueve al echarla y otra vez al minuto,: Stir as you put it in and again a minute later, so it does not stick to itself.
Pon los cacahuetes al lado en un plato p: Put the peanuts alongside on a small plate. If they are still in their shells, shell them first: 25 g of shelled peanuts is a handful that fits in a closed palm.
Sepárala en gajos con los dedos y sirve: Separate it into segments with your fingers and serve the walnuts alongside. If the walnuts taste rancid or bitter they are old: it is not your fault, throw them out.
Saca los frutos rojos del congelador y d: Take the berries out of the freezer and leave them 10 minutes in a bowl at room temperature.
Pon el skyr en un bol y remuévelo 10 seg: Put the skyr in a bowl and stir it for 10 seconds with a spoon: it comes very solid, and this way it turns creamy instead of staying in a block.
Remueve el bote de mantequilla de cacahu: Stir the jar of peanut butter before serving: the oil separates and rises to the top, and if you do not mix it back in the first spoonful is pure oil.
Pon las tortitas de arroz en un plato y: Put the rice cakes on a plate and spread the butter over them with the back of a spoon.
Si te molestan las espinas, abre la sard: If the bones bother you, open the sardine lengthways down the middle with the fork and pull on the central thread: it comes away whole, in one go. They are soft and perfectly edible, but nobody is making you.
Tuesta las dos rebanadas de pan hasta qu: Toast the two slices of bread until they are golden and firm to the touch.
Reparte la caballa sobre el pan ya tosta: Spread the mackerel over the bread once it is toasted, never over warm bread straight out of the toaster: hot soft bread soaks through and falls apart when you pick it up.
Sirve juntos en un plato. Un pellizco de: Serve them together on a plate. A pinch of salt on the tomato 5 minutes before eating draws the juice out and it tastes far more of itself.
Si la piña es de lata, escúrrela bien; s: If the pineapple is tinned, drain it well; if it is fresh, cut off the base and the crown, peel it from top to bottom and dig out any brown spots left behind.
Pon el requesón en un bol y reparte la p: Put the ricotta in a bowl and scatter the pineapple over it. Mix it just before eating: fresh pineapple turns ricotta to liquid if it sits mixed for any length of time.
Remueve el bote de mantequilla de cacahu: Stir the jar of peanut butter to work back in the oil that has separated on top.
Sirve la mantequilla en un montoncito al: Serve the butter in a little mound alongside and dip the wedges into it. Spreading it onto each wedge is slower and it falls off.
Remueve el skyr en un bol para soltarlo: Stir the skyr in a bowl to loosen it and scatter the kiwi over the top.
Pon el yogur en un bol y reparte las fre: Put the yoghurt in a bowl and scatter the strawberries over the top.
Saca el jamón de la nevera 10 minutos an: Take the ham out of the fridge 10 minutes beforehand: cold, the fat is hard and tastes of very little; at room temperature the aroma comes out.
Sirve las lonchas extendidas junto a los: Serve the slices laid out flat next to the wedges, not heaped up: stacked they stick to each other and then tear when you pull them apart.
Pon los huevos en una olla pequeña y cúb: Put the eggs in a small pan and cover them with cold water, two fingers above them. Starting in cold water keeps them from cracking as they go in.
Sácalos y ponlos en un bol con agua fría: Take them out and put them in a bowl of cold water for 2 minutes: it stops the cooking dead and the shell comes off far more easily.
Se come sacando el grano con los dientes: You eat it by squeezing the pod and pulling the beans out with your teeth. The pod is NOT eaten, it goes in the bin.
Reparte encima el queso primero y el pav: Lay the cheese on first and the turkey after: the cheese works as glue and stops the turkey sliding off when you pick it up.
Tuesta las rebanadas hasta que estén dor: Toast the slices until they are golden and sound hollow when you tap them.
Repártelo sobre el pan ya tostado y aplá: Spread it over the bread once it is toasted and press it down a little with the fork so it does not fall off when you bite.
Reparte el queso fresco batido por encim: Spread the quark over the top with the back of a spoon, without pressing: rice cakes snap under very little force.
Reparte las lonchas de pavo por encima,: Lay the turkey slices over the top, folded over on themselves rather than flat, so there is more juice in the bite.
Saca el pollo de la nevera 10 minutos an: Take the chicken out of the fridge 10 minutes beforehand. Cold in the middle, it is done on the outside before it is ready inside.
Si la pechuga es muy gruesa, ábrela por: If the breast is very thick, open it out through the middle like a book: that way it cooks in half the time and without staying raw in the centre.
Pon la sartén a fuego medio-alto con una: Put the pan on a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil and wait until the oil shines and runs around easily.
Retíralos del fuego cuando aún parezcan: Take them off the heat while they still look slightly underdone: the heat held in the pan finishes setting them on the plate. If you wait until they look ready, they arrive dry.
Saltea las espinacas 1 minuto en la sart: Sauté the spinach for 1 minute in the hot pan with a few drops of oil, until it collapses. It shrinks enormously: the huge handful comes down to nothing, and that is normal.
Si han soltado agua, escúrrela o apártal: If they have let out water, drain it off or set them aside: that water would make the egg whites watery.
Pon la zanahoria en una olla con un dedo: Put the carrot in a pan with a finger of water and a tablespoon of oil, cover it and cook for 6 minutes over a medium heat.
Prueba de sal antes de servir. Las de bo: Check for salt before serving. The tinned ones usually come out bland.
Rómpela con la cuchara en trozos pequeño: Break it up with the spoon into small pieces and sauté for 4 or 5 minutes, until there is no pink left anywhere.
Si suelta mucha agua, sube el fuego y de: If it lets out a lot of water, turn the heat up and let it evaporate before going on, or the dish ends up watery.

Ponlo sobre las patatas, con la piel hac: Put it on the potatoes, skin side down, and bake for another 12 minutes.
Sirve el huevo encima. Sala al final: lo: Serve the egg on top. Salt at the end: tinned chickpeas already have salt in them.
Sala la merluza por los dos lados y ponl: Salt the hake on both sides and put it in the colander with the vegetables and the potato in pieces around it.
Tapa y cuece al vapor 8 minutos. No dest: Cover and steam for 8 minutes. Do not keep lifting the lid: every time you do, the steam escapes and you are back at the start.
Pon la pasta a cocer en abundante agua h: Put the pasta on to cook in plenty of boiling water with a heaped tablespoon of salt.
Retírala a un plato mientras terminas, y: Move it onto a plate while you finish, and add the chopped tomato to the pan for 2 minutes so it breaks down.

Pon una olla con un litro de agua por ca: Put a pan on a high heat with a litre of water for every 100 g of pasta.
Prueba la pasta un minuto ANTES de lo qu: Taste the pasta a minute BEFORE the packet tells you to: tender but with some resistance to the bite. Drain it, keeping back half a glass of the water, and mix everything together.
Saca la carne con una cuchara pegada a l: Scoop the flesh out with a spoon held flat against the skin and cut it into slices. Do this AT THE END: cut avocado goes dark within minutes.
Seca los muslos con papel, sálalos y col: Pat the thighs dry with paper, salt them and lay them ON TOP of the potatoes: their fat drips down and makes the potatoes far better.
Saltea las espinacas 1 minuto en una sar: Sauté the spinach for 1 minute in a pan, or throw it onto the tray for the last 2 minutes.
Saltea las espinacas 1 minuto en la sart: Sauté the spinach for 1 minute in the pan with a few drops of oil and set it aside.
Si te gusta la yema cuajada, 2 minutos m: If you like the yolk set, another 2 minutes with the lid on.
Pon la pasta a cocer en agua hirviendo c: Put the pasta on to cook in boiling water with a heaped tablespoon of salt.
Saltéalo en la sartén a fuego medio-alto: Sauté it in the pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 3 minutes a side. The moment it loses the pink it is done: overcooked turkey ends up like sawdust.
Si queda seca, añade un poco del agua re: If it comes out dry, add a little of the water you kept back: it carries starch and binds the whole thing far better than oil does.
Prueba de sal, que suele hacer falta, y: Check for salt, which it usually needs, and serve it with the bread on the side for dipping.
Tritura con la batidora dentro de la oll: Blend with the stick blender down inside the pan, with the pan off the heat and the blender pushed right to the bottom before you switch it on: switch it on halfway up and it sprays boiling soup.
Si queda demasiado espesa, añade agua ca: If it comes out too thick, add hot water little by little. Adding it cold and all at once breaks the texture.
Salt at the end and serve it with the bread.
Seca el salmón muy bien con papel de coc: Pat the salmon very dry with kitchen paper, the skin above all. Damp skin never turns crisp.
